whenToUse: A price, fee, quote or projection that follows from a few answers: job size, seats and usage, session options, company type, a monthly amount and horizon.
Showing the line items behind a figure as the visitor changes inputs, then handing the selection to a contact form or booking.
Comparing what each plan would cost for the visitor's own numbers, with the cheapest that fits marked.
avoidWhen: Fixed packages without inputs — use pricing-table.
A long flow with contact details, dates and validation per step — use multi-step-form, and put an Estimator (or its formula) in one of the steps.
A two-axis choice where each cell has its own price — use choice-grid.
a11y: Inputs are kit controls (radio groups, checkbox cards, slider, switch, number field, native select) with visible labels; option groups are fieldsets named by their legend.
The figure is announced once per change through a polite live region; the narrow-screen bottom bar is decorative and its button moves focus to the summary panel.
